faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions for Buyers & Exporters
faq.desc: Key operational details on certifications, minimum order quantities, logistics, and quality assurance.

items.question: What commodities are available for export sourcing?
items.answer: We supply export-grade Rift Valley tomatoes, red onions, green peppers, highland potatoes, cabbage, green beans, fresh papaya, and certified hybrid seeds.

items.question: What certifications back Meki Batu Union produce?
items.answer: Our crops are GlobalG.A.P certified with full farm-gate traceability. We are also a licensed seed producer under Ethiopian national standards.

items.question: Which international markets do you currently supply?
items.answer: We supply European export markets via air freight, as well as Ethiopian Airlines Inflight Catering and wholesale buyers in East Africa.

items.question: How do I request a tailored volume quote?
items.answer: Submit the inquiry form on this page with your required commodity, tonnage, and destination. Our export team responds within 24 hours.

items.question: What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ)?
items.answer: MOQs depend on commodity perishability and seasonal windows. Contact us with your delivery schedule for custom volume terms.
